name: kql-not-anti-join
description: NOT is a per-solution anti-join, not a per-column subtraction (KIP §3.4.7.1): it removes exactly the tuples its whole block matches, and a multi-clause block only excludes what all of its clauses match together.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?t { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "PairNode"} } CONCEPT ?p1 { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "p1"} } CONCEPT ?p2 { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "p2"} } CONCEPT ?a1 { {type: "PairNode", name: "A1"} } CONCEPT ?a2 { {type: "PairNode", name: "A2"} } CONCEPT ?b1 { {type: "PairNode", name: "B1"} } CONCEPT ?b2 { {type: "PairNode", name: "B2"} } PROPOSITION ?l1 { (?a1, "p1", ?b1) } PROPOSITION ?l2 { (?a2, "p1", ?b2) } PROPOSITION ?l3 { (?a1, "p2", ?b2) } PROPOSITION ?l4 { (?a2, "p2", ?b2) } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?user_t { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "GUser"} } CONCEPT ?bot_t { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "GBot"} } CONCEPT ?human_t { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "GHuman"} } CONCEPT ?linked { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "linked"} } CONCEPT ?blocked { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "blocked"} } CONCEPT ?ua1 { {type: "GUser", name: "UA1"} } CONCEPT ?ua2 { {type: "GUser", name: "UA2"} } CONCEPT ?tb1 { {type: "GBot", name: "TB1"} } CONCEPT ?tb2 { {type: "GHuman", name: "TB2"} } PROPOSITION ?g1 { (?ua1, "linked", ?tb1) } PROPOSITION ?g2 { (?ua2, "linked", ?tb2) } PROPOSITION ?g3 { (?ua1, "blocked", ?tb1) } PROPOSITION ?g4 { (?ua2, "blocked", ?tb2) } }

cases.name: sequential patterns join pair-wise, not by endpoint sets
NOT excludes solutions, not binding columns
a NOT block sharing three variables removes exactly the matching tuples
a later clause inside NOT narrows what the block excludes
